coverage_override.reason: Pendulum protection, Xyz material condition, shared summon/GY attachment trigger, Quick Effect, and destroyed/Tributed Pendulum placement are the five individual effect records; their shared HOPT sentence is incorporated into the affected records.

effects.printed_clause: Pendulum Effect: Your opponent cannot target "Shining Brigade" monsters you control with Spell/Trap effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A P-Zone field effect protects controlled archetype monsters only from an opponent's Spell/Trap targeting effects.

official_references.matched_structure: Official opponent-only targeting protection uses EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with a player/effect-type value check.

effects.lua_implementation: AddXyzProcedure requires three or more Level 2 Shining Brigade materials.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz procedure with fixed Level and minimum material count.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Summoned, or, if a monster is sent to your opponent's GY while this card is on the field: You can attach 1 face-up card your opponent controls to this card as material.
effects.lua_implementation: Shared-HOPT triggers now cover Special Summon and Flip Summon of this Xyz Monster, plus EVENT_TO_GRAVE while it is in the Monster Zone; resolution overlays one face-up opponent card.

official_references.matched_structure: Official text 'If this card is Summoned' registers Normal, Flip, and Special Summon event clones; this Extra Deck monster requires the applicable Flip and Special events.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: an Xyz Monster cannot be Normal Summoned, but it can be Flip Summoned after being put face-down; EVENT_FLIP_SUMMON_SUCCESS was missing.

effects.printed_clause: (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card; destroy 1 card your opponent controls, then banish 1 card in either player's GY.
effects.lua_implementation: The Quick Effect detaches two materials as cost, destroys one opponent field card without targeting, and proceeds to banish one legal GY card only after successful destruction.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz effect removes overlay material as cost.
Official sequential operation gates the later operation on successful destruction.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect, or Tributed: You can place it in your Pendulum Zone. You can only use each effect of "Shining Brigade Origins" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_DESTROYED checks battle/effect destruction and a shared-HOPT EVENT_RELEASE clone handles Tributing; either moves the handler to an available Pendulum Zone.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Pendulum placement moves a card into an available Pendulum Zone.
Official cloned triggers can share one hard once-per-turn code.
